Born for E-Sports

In e-sports, we must race against time, because even the slightest delay can reverse the situation. Therefore, in order to create the most favorable situation for players, GameSir X2 uses a wired connection, which greatly reduces the time required for the device signal to reach the mobile phone, and truly realizes plug and play. With almost no delayed input, you can control the situation at any time without leaving the opponent's chances.

Unique Patent — 51° Adjustable Type-C Plug

Are you worried about damage to the charging port or plug when installing your phone? Don’t worry, our GameSir team has applied for an exclusive and innovative patent for GameSir X2, which enables X2 to have an adjustable Type-C plug with a maximum adjustment range of 51 degrees, allowing you to easily plug and unplug the phone and protect the phone from damage.

Gamers Most Trusted Partner

GameSir X2 is determined to become the most trusted partner of players in the game, so we have been working hard to improve product quality and user experience. For example, the service life of the micro switch button is up to 3 million times, and the soft rubber grip provides a comfortable hand-held feeling. These are the designs of GameSir X2, aiming to provide gamers with an excellent gaming experience.

Durable Stretch Design

Don't worry that GameSir X2 will not fit the size of your phone. Its retractable design allows you to install a mobile phone with a maximum length of 173mm. At the same time, the internal spring is sturdy and durable and can withstand countless stretches. All this will become your most reliable partner!

Ultra-low Power Consumption

GameSir X2 has no built-in battery and is powered by the mobile phone through the Type-C port. But X2 consumes only one-tenth of its power per hour, which is enough to ensure that you can play games for a long time. In addition, players can directly charge their phones through the Type-C port of X2. If your phone is running low when you are playing games with the X2, just connect the charging cable to the X2 itself to charge the phone.

Small Details for Good Gaming Experience

GameSir X2 has some details that you may not notice, but they can improve your gaming experience in many ways.
1. X2 is equipped with two clickable e-sports joysticks, which are comparable to professional game controllers.
2. Between the mobile phone and X2, we have reserved a little gap to ensure air circulation, so that your phone can maintain good heat dissipation.
3. X2 has a screenshot button, and game players can keep the most precious, interesting and memorable game moments at any time through the one-click screenshot function.

Cloud Gaming is the Future

The emergence of cloud gaming heralds future changes in games, and GameSir X2 is ready for this. X2 is compatible with most cloud games and various popular cloud gaming platforms, such as Microsoft xCloud, Xbox Game Pass, Sony PlayStation Now, Google STADIA, NVIDIA GeForce Now, Parsec, LiquidSky, Hatch: Play, Shadow.tech, Vortex, NetEase Cloud Games and Tencent Start, etc. GameSir X2 can bring you an excellent gaming experience.
